function.name: calculate_electric_current
function.description: Calculate the electric current through a conductor given voltage and resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

voltage.description: The voltage across the conductor in Volts. This is a float type value.

resistance.description: The resistance of the conductor in Ohms. This is a float type value.

conductance.description: The conductance of the conductor in Siemens. Optional if resistance is provided. Default: 0.3 This is a float type value.

message.content:
電力的「發現」其實是一個漸進的歷史過程。古代人已經注意到靜電現象（如摩擦產生的靈電），但真正把電學系統化、量化並應用於科技的，主要是以下幾位科學家：

| 時期 | 科學家 | 主要貢獻 |
|------|--------|----------|
| 1600s | 威廉·吉爾伯特 (William Gilbert) | 首次將電與磁區分，提出「電」一詞，撰寫《De Magnete》 |
| 1700s | 本傑明·富蘭克林 (Benjamin Franklin) | 研究閃電與靜電，提出正負電荷概念，發明避雷針 |
| 1800s | 阿萊桑德羅·伏打 (Alessandro Volta) | 發明伏打電池，提供持續電流來源 |
| 1800s | 亞歷山大·貝爾 (Alexander Graham Bell) | 發明電話，利用電信號傳遞聲音 |
| 1800s | 尤利西斯·格雷戈里 (Michael Faraday) | 發明電磁感應原理，為電動機與發電機奠定基礎 |

因此，雖然「電」的存在早已被古人觀察，但將其轉化為可測量、可利用的能量形式，則是由上述科學家們在不同時期共同推進的結果。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "誰發現了電力？" meaning "Who discovered electricity?" They want an answer. We can provide a concise answer: Electricity was known since ancient times but modern discovery credited to scientists like William Gilbert, Benjamin Franklin, Alessandro Volta, etc. But the question might be ambiguous. Provide a short answer. No function call needed.
